reading.title: DOE Steam Tip Sheet 9, Minimize Boiler Blowdown, January 2012
reading.locator: Complete pages 1–2, functions, conditional rates and automatic/proportional control alternatives
reading.scope: Bottom/mud suspended-solids removal is distinct from surface dissolved-solids control. Rate context uses feedwater. Existing proportional makeup-water-flow control is an alternative; an analyzer tag alone establishes neither applicability nor adequacy. Historical standard references are not a current-standard review.

reading.title: DOE Steam Tip Sheet 10, Recover Heat from Boiler Blowdown, January 2012
reading.locator: Complete pages 1–2, opening screening sentence, table/example and receiving uses
reading.scope: The opening steam-rate screen differs from the feedwater denominator in the table/example. Actual pressure, duty, hours, recovery and receiving conditions matter. No universal site target, retrofit instruction or saving follows. This supplement does not reverify inherited S19/S24/IAC benefit figures.

reading.title: DOE and Hydraulic Institute, Improving Pumping System Performance, second edition
reading.locator: Printed pages 25–26 / PDF pages 29–30, highly throttled valves and bypass functions
reading.scope: Pump/system duty, valve characterization and control performance qualify the opening discussion. Bypasses may protect against pressure differential or serve temperature control. The old C4 excerpt omitted intervening characterization context; its replacement is a qualified paraphrase, not a universal opening threshold or quantified benefit.

reading.title: DOE FEMP Best Management Practice 10, Cooling Tower Management
reading.locator: Overview and Operation and Maintenance: chemistry constraints, conductivity/flow comparisons, losses/components and logs
reading.scope: Evaporative recirculating-water management; treatment-limited targets, matched water/measurement records and unexplained losses. Conductivity and flow ratios need an appropriate quantity/unit/time basis. The source recommendations do not supply site authority or prove current installed coverage.

authorship: Source-supported distinctions plus authored records-first collection and evidence-integrity policies. Informed independent agent review; not a human process-engineer approval, verified source authority, site acceptance or arbitrary diagnostic benchmark.
copyright_and_custody: Original source bytes and page captures remain outside the public repository; only links, locators, hashes and bounded paraphrases are provided. Catalog attribution/licensing statements remain unchanged. No new redistribution assurance is made.
